_notes.image_source: PLACEHOLDER IMAGES. Every `image` below is a picsum.photos stand-in that merely holds the composition's layout. Swap each one for an AI-generated still (ruins, artifacts, dramatic landscapes) served from the image API, e.g. `https://cdn.12thstreet.tv/episodes/0001/scene-1.jpg`; nothing else in the pipeline changes.
_notes.orientation: Long-form stills should be 1920x1080. For vertical shorts use 1080x1920 stills and `node render.js --vertical`.

scenes.caption: Six thousand years ago, the first cities rose out of the mud of the Tigris and the Euphrates.
Priests read the night sky from the ziggurats, and pressed the harvest into clay.
Empires rose, burned, and were buried. Their stones are still speaking.
